obiConfigText:
attributes:
  kubernetes:
    enable: true
discovery:
  instrument:
  - k8s_deployment_name: edge-nginx
    namespace: obi-nginx-example
ebpf:
  context_propagation: all
  traffic_control_backend: tc
filter:
  network:
    k8s_dst_owner_name:
      not_match: '{kube*,*jaeger-agent*,*prometheus*,*promtail*,*grafana-agent*}'
    k8s_src_owner_name:
      not_match: '{kube*,*jaeger-agent*,*prometheus*,*promtail*,*grafana-agent*}'
network:
  enable: true
  source: tc
otel_metrics_export:
  endpoint: http://${HOST_IP}:4318
otel_traces_export:
  endpoint: http://${HOST_IP}:4317
prometheus_export:
  path: /metrics
  port: 9090
trace_printer: text
